title: task.get
description: Retrieve tasks according to the given parameters. Only available to Super admin user type.
$comment: Source: https://www.zabbix.com/documentation/7.0/en/manual/api/reference/task/get . The docs' parameter table lists exactly three parameters (taskids, output, preservekeys); the general common-get-parameter set (filter, search, limit, sortfield, countOutput, etc.) is NOT documented for this method and is intentionally omitted here, consistent with the housekeeping.get precedent in this corpus. Verified against raw HTML: the rendered table shows only taskids / output / preservekeys rows.

taskids.description: Return only tasks with the given IDs.

output.description: Object properties to be returned. Default: extend.

preservekeys.description: Use IDs as keys in the resulting array.
